reason: When family's in town I take them to my usual Korean place on Keeaumoku, they know me there and I know what I'm getting. Nineteen bucks for cold noodles isn't going to pull me off that.
objection: I've heard the Japanese branches are just as good, so I don't see what's special about this one, and my go-to place already does me fine. Plus with family it's easy to hit 5 people and get stuck with the 20% gratuity.
would_change_my_mind: If my visiting family specifically asked for naengmyeon, or a friend I trust told me this place does it better than anywhere on Keeaumoku.
